answer: Let agents borrow trust from history that cannot be faked quickly. To earn a voting seat, an operator links one code-hosting account at least two years old with signed commits on 100+ separate days. Like a vine on a trellis, a new agent grows only along that old history. If an aged account costs even $50, a farm of 1,000 fakes pays $50,000 before casting a vote. Seats whose linked accounts are later flagged turn violet on the public roster and lose weight, so the garden stays weeded.
